support.title: Help & feedback
support.headline: How can we help?

feature.title: Suggest a feature
feature.body: Something Hypeline should do, or do better.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.body: Something broke or looks wrong. The report comes with your version and browser filled in.

question.title: Ask a question
question.body: How does something work? Is something possible?

support.footer: Everything opens as a public issue on the project's

example.title: A sample stream
example.clipLocked: This is the example VOD — paste a real one to cut clips.
example.aiLocked: AI is off on the example VOD — it has no video and a made-up chat.

tour.settingsHint: New here? A 30-second walk through the desk.

heatmap.title: The heatmap
heatmap.body: The whole stream as one ribbon: the thicker and brighter it gets, the louder the chat was. Every pin is a moment. Click anywhere to seek; scroll to zoom in.

moments.title: Moments
moments.body: The peaks, ranked. Hover one for its frame and why chat exploded; click it to set a clip range around it. The slider decides how many surface.

clip.title: Clip
clip.body: Trim the range on the frames, pick a preset (TikTok, Shorts, X…), captions and quality, then export — it is cut in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

ai.title: AI, your key
ai.body: Optional. Transcribe a range, ask what happened, or search the whole stream by what was said. It runs on your own NanoGPT key; costs show before every call.

rail.title: The rail
rail.body: Paste any Twitch VOD link (or a live channel) here. Your cached VODs and clips live below; the ? sends feedback. This example is yours to delete with its ×.

storage.title: Storage
storage.lagNote: Everything lives in this browser only. After a clear, the browser frees the space in the background, so its total can lag for a while.
storage.eraseHint: Wipe all of the above. Your settings and key stay.

install.title: Install Hypeline
install.body: Opens in its own window, works offline
